description: This file defines a React component for a rerouting dialog in a scheduling or booking application, including related hooks, utility functions, and subcomponents for managing rerouting workflows, status, and user interactions.

methods.name: getEventTypeUrlsForTheChosenRoute
methods.description: Generates URLs for the selected route, including redirect URL and full slug based on route and form responses.

methods.name: rescheduleInNewTab
methods.description: Opens a new browser tab with the specified URL for rerouting.

methods.name: getFullSlugForEvent
methods.description: Constructs a full slug string for an event type, including team slug.

methods.name: isBookingTimeslotInPast
methods.description: Checks if the booking's start time is before the current time.

methods.name: useReroutingState
methods.description: Custom hook managing rerouting process state, including progress, success, and failure.

methods.name: gotoBookingPage
methods.description: Navigates to the booking page for a given booking UID.

methods.name: useEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for message and unload events related to rerouting.

methods.name: NewRoutingManager
methods.description: Component managing rerouting actions, including rescheduling and status display.

methods.name: CurrentRoutingStatus
methods.description: Component displaying current routing status details.

methods.name: RerouteDialogContentAndFooter
methods.description: Component rendering the rerouting form and footer buttons.

methods.name: RerouteDialogContentAndFooterWithFormResponse
methods.description: Component handling form response and rerouting confirmation.

methods.name: RerouteDialog
methods.description: Main component rendering the rerouting dialog with validation and subcomponents.
